title: Add JSON output for audit purge
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant audit purge --json` so retention automation can record audit maintenance without parsing human text.
expectedFailureModes: Retention automation parses `purged N event(s)` and breaks on wording changes.
`--json` omits the cutoff used for the purge, making purge receipts hard to correlate.
Live audit coverage exercises recent and verify paths but never tests retention against a real daemon.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomous backlog item.
